scopeRationale: The original shared-density matrices were diagnostic comparisons, not a global DP physical qualification. All invalid raw DP outputs remain physical failures, unchanged by Gate A; no originally qualified DU/B1/B4A/B4B/B4C state regresses. No raw-return count is promoted to success, no quality clamp or tolerance is applied, and no model consumes these DP diagnostics.
